result.summary: Independently re-verified all 13 files' scope and .zig citation counts (sum 345, unchanged from step-00 baseline). Both new edge cases -- (a) a bare code fence not immediately preceded by a heading (req074), marker placed above the fence as a paragraph-like unit; (b) a heading whose only .zig citation lives inside a blockquote body below it (req078, S7.4/S8.1), marker placed above the heading/intro line rather than inserting a blockquote-prefixed line -- are defensible extensions of REQ-237's closest-matching-rule guidance and are non-destructive. Divergence notes (req076: 2, req078: 1; total 3) confirmed byte-identical before and after. Zero content deletion confirmed via git diff --stat (220 insertions, 0 deletions across 13 files). List-continuation indentation used in the marker insertions is consistent with REQ-267's own precedent. No scope leakage outside the 13-file owned_modules list.
issues: Recommend folding both new precedents (list-continuation indentation; heading-covers-blockquote-citation placement) into REQ-237's design doc so REQ-269/270/271 don't have to re-derive them. Filed as a lightweight follow-up note rather than a full new issue, since the pattern itself is already validated correct -- next sibling-chunk run should surface this in its own bookkeeping/handoff.
result.next_action: Proceed to merge. Doc-only mechanical marker-insertion change, no test coverage applicable (consistent with REQ-264/267 precedent) -- no TEST-DESIGNER step needed.
